The linked formalization proves the stronger coefficient-injectivity statement used in the paper: for any group $A$ and any relator in $A*\mathbb Z$ whose exponent sum in the cyclic generator is $1$ or $-1$, the natural map from $A$ into the quotient by that relator is injective. This is the selected unimodular-relator result underlying the conjecture.” Quoted, not judged: AMVO has not compared this Lean statement with the family's claims or with the manuscripts.
